analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: the last-updated date (line 3) and the `stop` row in the sampling-parameter table (patch hunk near head line 2122). I reviewed the supplied head text for lines 1217-2023 and the patch excerpt. The text covers the GLM media/vision budget, prefix-cache, calibration, deadline and MTP sections. None of these sections is itself modified, so they provide context only.

The documented stop-sequence scoping change is that Gemma 4 and `<think>` parsers exclude reasoning and tool-call spans per request (`ReasoningStopScope`). This is documentation of behavior implemented in code outside this PR; no code change is supplied. Scoping stop matching to the answer span could in principle affect output-integrity or truncation semantics. It could also affect whether hidden reasoning leaks through a stop sequence, which touches T-008, A-001 and T-056. I found no new trust boundary, authorization, attestation, encryption or cache-storage change. The T-041 prefix-cache statements in the visible text are consistent with the canonical threat model: encrypted SSD tier, per-scope isolation, and no new at-rest metadata. I could not verify the underlying implementation (`EngineV2Bridge+StopSequence.swift`, `ReasoningStopScope`), which is outside the supplied evidence. No finding is raised because the doc-only change introduces no verified regression. The threat model does not appear to need an update from this PR.
